requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online without calling
Patients must have secure online access to test results after clinician approval
System must allow GPs and nurses to manage their appointment schedules
System must have a feature to flag urgent cases for same-day appointments
Portal must have a clean and straightforward design with clear labels
Portal must provide step-by-step guidance for booking appointments
Portal must adhere to accessibility guidelines for all users
Portal must offer larger text options, voice commands, and video tutorials
Portal must be mobile-friendly for use on smartphones
System must be cost-effective and provide good value for money
Portal must integrate seamlessly with existing practice management software
System must comply with GDPR and relevant data protection laws
System must be easy to train staff with minimal additional training required
Portal must accommodate varying levels of digital literacy among patients
